protocol.sampleEncoding: 8-bit bin centers; z,y,x; frame cycle shift (37,71) every 32 frames; independent masks for dimensions
protocol.cameraMotion: background one integer pixel right per frame, nearer foreground occluder two pixels right per frame; exact per-object previous-pixel reprojection; revealed boundary and object-ID changes reset history
protocol.movingBlocker: blocker center x=0.6*sin(frame*0.08); no perfect-history assumption
metrics: noiseRMSE versus identically filtered analytic truth history
protocol.limitations: Correlated prefixes and filters are diagnostics, not independent trials. Two independent seed pairs, finite geometric scenes, no full renderer/PBR or performance extrapolation. GGX is normal/lobe environment sampling, not a complete BRDF estimator.
